hardening.minimized_reason: Build HTTP(S)-only curl without unused protocols, authentication backends, cookies, MIME or optional compression libraries.
hardening.pledge_reason: The Pi-hole form confines the service; curl does not enforce package-level capability grants.

changes.what: Install a musl curl executable only inside the Pi-hole OCI tree, with libcurl linked in and solver dependency/provide inference disabled.
changes.why: Preserve the OCI image ABI and its TLS/zlib libraries without altering the host Wolfi package solver.

wolfi.removal_condition: The Pi-hole OCI image supplies an equivalent restricted curl and its blocklist/confinement tests pass.
